coordinateSystem: 488x680; references only; pAfter=center+scale*(pBefore-center)+(tx,ty), center=(244,340); pixels.normalize handles source resolution/letterboxing first
policy: One shared translation and uniform scale fitted on frozen calibration cards to the retained painter outer printed plate, equally weighted by material. No text, art, HSB, rotation, anisotropic or per-scan fitting. Held-out cards only validate the frozen transform. ABU black stock uses normalized gradient profiles of the plate border to separate its narrow bevel from the adjacent cast shadow and faint bitmap edge. Other families use stock boundaries. Residual opposed boundaries remain a source-geometry diagnostic.

guards.runtime: Require set, stock, normal layout, family, exact pinned frame URL, frame rectangle and mask URL. Byte hashes document the cached sources and need not trigger another runtime download.

geometryTransfers.policy: Exact equality of every retained frame/plate anchor target; original reference cohorts and transforms retained.
